results.title: Revel
results.overview: The film follows three female artists -- an actress, a novelist and a photographer -- as they land at an elite women’s retreat on the Bay of Fundy.

results.title: Valleys of the Earth
results.overview: Valleys of the Earth is a story of redemption set in a post-apocalyptic United States several years after an enormous solar plunges Humanity into a new Dark Age. From the ashes, a militarized cult known as "the Watchers" rises. Led by their prophets, the Watchers believe this apocalyptic event was brought on by their Angels, and that it is as a means of giving humanity a fresh start. Isaac, our protagonist, attempts to flee his past and right his wrongs. Along the way, his story becomes entwined with Kellen, a young woman fiercely dedicated to upholding a promise she once made. If the two are to survive, they must learn to trust one another; however, the Watchers are everywhere, and will stop at nothing to recover what they have lost.

results.title: The Illusion of an Everlasting Summer
results.original_title: La ilusión de un verano sin fin
results.overview: Filmed over 25 years, acclaimed photographer Alessandra Sanguinetti traces the lives of two inseparable cousins in the Argentine farmlands, beginning as a childhood game of fantasy and evolving into a profound collaborative study of time, memory, and womanhood.

results.title: Jonás
results.overview: Jonás, a teenager about to become a father, has secretly decided to escape.

results.title: Zero Meets Hero
results.overview: War veteran Mr Thoi and his Gen Z grandson Tri Binh embark on a comedic journey to reunite with old war comrades, weaving together Vietnamese spiritual beliefs and generational bonds.

results.title: This Is Buzz
results.overview: A mind-blowing music documentary about the first immersive TV show on MTV when MTV was cool.

results.title: The Return
results.overview: Ivan and Ana, a young couple from Belgrade, arrive to Begaljica to sell their grandfather's old house. The rural idyll, as well as meeting a friendly grandma, affects their relationship.

Follow a group of eight explorers and two leaders who reach a mountain refuge in the Pyrenees, only to be cut off by a snowstorm. When they take a headcount, they discover an extra child that no one remembers.

results.title: Kaïros
results.overview: After a year of filming abroad, Manu, a once prominent actor, returns to his hometown. But getting back into the business isn't as easy as he thought. After several unsuccessful auditions, he's no longer sure of anything. Against all odds, he lands a job hosting a nighttime call-in radio show. His listeners are mainly newcomers, refugees and exiles with varied life experiences, working graveyard shifts. Manu gradually appropriates this space, this gathering of mixed voices, to launch philosophical questions into the night. His words are engaging. He becomes an anchor for many listeners. His life takes on new meaning.

results.title: Invisible Enemy
results.overview: Mark and Harri are two Finnish men who have volunteered to fight in Ukraine. Their return to civilian life proves difficult: PTSD symptoms, clinging to the emotional extremes caused by war, and the struggle to find meaning in life at times feel overwhelming. In trauma-informed therapy, these symptoms are processed and their experiences revisited.

results.title: The Secret Floor
results.overview: When 12-year-old Karli moves to an old hotel in the Alps, he discovers an elevator that harbors a secret – it’s a magical time portal that transports him back to 1938! There, he befriends Hannah, a spirited Jewish girl, and Georg, a shoeshine boy. But when Georg is falsely accused of stealing, the children must solve a mystery case hidden within the hotel’s walls, all while the shadow of Nazi Germany begins to grow around them.

results.title: Chameli Ko Poi
results.overview: Chameli and Shere are friends, lovers, spouses, and rivals whose relationship is tested by humor, romance, and unexpected twists when Chameli’s scheming brother-in-law interferes for his own benefit.

results.title: Battle of the Zombie Staplers
results.overview: Years since the Zombie Staplers disappeared, Christian has been trying to lead a normal life. But after his one true love is kidnapped, he must enter the underworld of Miami where he reconnects with old allies and learns about a new Zombie Stapler plot that might eliminate humanity once and for all.

results.title: Palace Detroit 313
results.overview: A skate video by Palace, filmed in Detroit over a seven-year period (2018–2025).

results.title: Stories About My Body
results.overview: In a tiny theatre in Aotearoa, New Zealand, four teenage stagehands work tirelessly to help Morgana tell the stories that shaped her - from her own teenagehood in 1998, to working foot-fetish parties in New York City, to falling in love and later birthing her babies in a Melbourne living room.  By turns vulnerable and riotously funny, she moves from lamenting her chins to marvelling at her cellular functions, using her body as the living template for every tale she tells.  Created and performed by Morgana O'Reilly (The White Lotus) and co-directed with her husband and real-life birth partner, 2025 BAFTA nominee Peter Salmon (After The Party), Stories About My Body blends nudity, heart-swelling honesty and real birth footage into a stand-up comedy special like no other - intimate, fearless and unexpectedly profound.
